newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo retreats against mark, central bank unseen.
newsitem.headline: Escudo retreats against mark, central bank unseen.

text.p: The escudo retreated sharply against the German mark on Thursday but there was no sign of intervention by the Bank of Portugal.
The currency was trading at 100.92/96 after touching a low of 100.98 to the mark with traders saying that it could push lower.
They said that sales by non-residents were pushing the currency down.
"The market is buyer of marks. As there is no sign of the Bank of Portugal intervening, this could continue," said one trader.
Nevertheless, the currency was appearing to regain some poise, trading at 100.86/89 at 1009 GMT.
Traders said that the foreign selling of the escudo appeared to have been triggered by stop-loss orders.
